items.prompt: Every school day, Mei ___ to school.
items.hint: Think about a repeated habit and the subject.
items.explanation: Mei is singular. Use walks for a present habit.

items.prompt: My brother ___ not like spicy food.
items.hint: This describes his usual preference.
items.explanation: Use does not with a singular third-person subject.

items.prompt: Our lessons ___ at nine every morning.
items.hint: The subject is plural.
items.explanation: Lessons is plural, so use start.

items.prompt: Yesterday, we ___ the science museum.
items.hint: Yesterday identifies a finished past time.
items.explanation: Use visited for this completed event.

items.prompt: Last night, Sam did not ___ his bag.
items.hint: The auxiliary did already marks past tense.
items.explanation: Use the base form pack after did not.

items.prompt: Two days ago, I ___ my library card.
items.hint: The event happened at a specified past time.
items.explanation: Lost is the past form of lose.

items.prompt: I started living here in 2022 and still live here. I ___ here since 2022.
items.hint: The situation continues to the present.
items.explanation: Have lived connects the past starting point with now.

items.prompt: We are still waiting. The bus ___ yet.
items.hint: Yet refers to the situation up to now.
items.explanation: Has not arrived describes an expected event that has not happened up to now.

items.prompt: I cannot find my keys now. I ___ them.
items.hint: The past event has a present result.
items.explanation: Have lost connects losing the keys with the current problem.

items.prompt: I have known Asha ___ three years.
items.hint: Three years is a duration.
items.explanation: Use for with a length of time.

items.prompt: Leo has lived here ___ January.
items.hint: January identifies the starting point.
items.explanation: Use since with a starting point.

items.prompt: I lived in Macau ___ two years, then moved to Hong Kong.
items.hint: The duration is complete in the past.
items.explanation: For can accompany past simple. It does not require present perfect.

items.prompt: At eight last night, I was in the middle of my homework. I ___ it.
items.hint: Focus on an activity in progress at that past time.
items.explanation: Was doing presents the ongoing activity.

items.prompt: The phone rang while we ___ dinner.
items.hint: Dinner was in progress when another event occurred.
items.explanation: Were eating gives the background activity.

items.prompt: When the lights went out, Mum ___ a book.
items.hint: The reading was already in progress.
items.explanation: Was reading describes the ongoing action interrupted by the power cut.

items.prompt: I arrived home, and then I opened the window. When I ___ home, I opened the window.
items.hint: These are successive completed events.
items.explanation: When can connect two past-simple events.

items.prompt: The doorbell interrupted my homework. I ___ when it rang.
items.hint: Which action was already in progress?
items.explanation: Past continuous gives the background. Rang gives the interrupting event.

items.prompt: Choose the sentence showing two successive completed events.
choices: When I arrived, I took off my coat.
When I arrived, I was taking off my coat.
When I arriving, I took off my coat.
items.hint: The arrival happened first.
items.explanation: Arrived and took describe the intended sequence. The continuous alternative changes the time relationship.

items.prompt: Every day, she ___ (read) for pleasure.
items.hint: Use a singular present-tense verb.
items.explanation: She reads expresses a habit.

items.prompt: Last Saturday, we ___ (go) to the beach.
items.hint: Go has an irregular past form.
items.explanation: Went is the past simple of go.

items.prompt: I ___ (know) Ben since we were six. We are still friends.
items.hint: The relationship continues now.
items.explanation: Have known describes the continuing situation.

items.prompt: I have waited ___ twenty minutes.
items.hint: Use a duration expression.
items.explanation: For introduces a length of time.

items.prompt: I ___ (study) when the alarm rang and interrupted me.
items.hint: The study was already in progress.
items.explanation: Was studying describes the interrupted activity.

items.prompt: When the bus ___ (arrive), we got on.
items.hint: The arrival was a completed event.
items.explanation: Arrived and got describe successive past events.
